thread:
nora: Noticed a spike in duplicate onboarding tasks this morning. ~45 trials got two sets of welcome tasks. Customers are confused.

devin: Any correlated deploys or infra changes overnight?

nora: No deploys on cs-services. Ops-bot alerted at 06:05 UTC: `playbook-runner: event_queue_processor_restarted` and then we have duplicate webhook deliveries to CRM.

ops-bot: WARNING: playbook-runner delivery latency > 5s (queue length 280)

lia: Queue length 280 is concerning. Could be a backlog + at-least-once delivery causing duplicates, or our dedupe window is too narrow.

mike: Our webhook ack protocol is idempotent by idempotency_key which is request_id. If the runner retried before storing ack, CRM would create duplicates. Did CRM return 200s?

nora: CRM logs show rapid succession of 202 Accepted, then later 200. But we also logged a `consumer-restart` at 06:05. Maybe replay happened.

paul: I pulled a sample: two events for the same trial (trial_12987) 06:04:57 and 06:05:02 with different request_ids. Both created tasks. Dedupe at CRM uses `external_id` field which we set to "trial-<id>-welcome" but our code sometimes omitted external_id on replay.

tara: That explains it. Why omitted? recent change to playbook-runner v3.0 changed how payload is composed (moved external_id into metadata subobject). CRM expects top-level external_id for dedupe.

lia: Oof. We shipped a small payload shape change in the minor release. QA didn't catch replay edge-case.

nora: Short term mitigation: 1) rollback runner to v2.9.8, 2) run CRM dedupe cleanup for affected tenants, 3) backfill missing external_id for replayed events to prevent future duplicates. Who can take which?

mike: I can do (1) now. Rolling back in 5m.

```bash
# mike
kubectl -n apps set image deployment/playbook-runner playbook-runner=registry.redwood/playbook-runner:v2.9.8
kubectl -n apps rollout status deployment/playbook-runner
```

mike: Rollback started, pods cycling.

paul: For (2) I can run a CRM query to detect duplicate welcome tasks created within a 2-minute window and mark extras as "duplicate:system" so CS sees one canonical task. Running a dry-run first.

```sql
-- paul: duplicates dry-run
SELECT tenant_id, trial_id, COUNT(*) as c
FROM tasks
WHERE type='welcome' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-04-16T05:50:00Z' AND '2026-04-16T06:20:00Z'
GROUP BY tenant_id, trial_id
HAVING c > 1
LIMIT 200;
```

paul: Dry-run found 47 trial rows. Will run cleanup with `UPDATE tasks SET status='duplicate:system' WHERE id IN (...) AND is_oldest=false;` after approval.

lia: Approve cleanup. Also request that we export the list to CS so they can notify impacted customers gracefully.

nora: I'll draft a CS note and add a small email explaining we fixed duplicate tasks and no action needed.

ops-bot: playbook-runner rollout complete. image=registry.redwood/playbook-runner:v2.9.8

mike: Rollback success. New error rate for deliveries dropped to baseline.

paul: Cleanup job ran. 45 tasks marked duplicate:system. I pushed CSV to 
https://storage.redwood.internal/cs/dupe-cleanup/2026-04-16.csv

lia: Two follow-ups: 1) extend dedupe acceptance to read external_id from payload.metadata.external_id when present (backwards compatible), 2) add a replay acceptance test in integration suite to simulate consumer restarts and verify dedupe.

devin: Also add a CI check that validates payload schema against CRM contract for both v2 and v3 shapes. Will raise a PR to the test harness.

tara: I'll open the playbook-runner issue linking the payload change, tag it rollback and add a checklist to include replay tests before cutting releases.

nora: Owners: @mike - rollback/monitoring, @paul - CRM cleanup + artifacts, @tara - runner issue + release checklist, @devin - schema CI test, @lia - dedupe change. I'll coordinate customer comms.

mike: Monitoring: task creation rate normalized. No more duplicates in last 30m.

nora: Great. Add to the onboarding healthscore note: if welcome task never ran (in other incidents) or duplicate runs occurred, we should recompute healthscore for the affected trials once tasks are normalized. @paul can you add a column in the CSV with `needs_recompute` boolean?

paul: Done. CSV now has needs_recompute=true for 39 trials. Location same as before.

lia: I'll pick up a small migration to accept metadata.external_id in CRM dedupe code. Will target next patch.

nora: Thanks everyone. Small postmortem in the runbook: root cause = payload shape change + missing replay QA. Fixes = rollback, CRM cleanup, dedupe patch, replay test, schema CI. Closing once PRs merged.

ops-bot: INCIDENT: RESOLVED - duplicate-onboarding-tasks - 2026-04-16T06:45:00Z
